company_profile.name: Devzk
company_profile.business_field: Software Development, AI Solutions & Digital Creative Agency
company_profile.description: Devzk is a modern tech and creative agency offering Software Development, Web Development, AI Automations, Chatbots, and Multimedia services.
company_profile.office_status: Hum abhi physically office nahi rakhte, hum 100% remotely kaam karte hain (Worldwide / Remote Agency).

leadership_and_team.full_team_list:
• CEO: Muhammad Ryan Zubair
• COO: Muhammad Toseef
• CMO: Muhammad Ahmad Kashif
• CTO: Haider Ali
• Manager: Meharzad Waseem

services.name: Software Development
services.description: Custom desktop, web, and enterprise software solutions tailored to your business needs.

services.name: Website Development
services.description: Modern, responsive, fast websites, web apps, and eCommerce stores.

services.name: AI Automations
services.description: End-to-end business workflow automations using AI to save time and reduce manual work.

services.name: AI Chatbots & AI Integrations
services.description: Intelligent WhatsApp, web, and CRM chatbots integrated with OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, etc.

services.name: Video Editing
services.description: Professional video editing for YouTube, Reels, TikTok, ads, and corporate videos.

services.name: Graphic Designing
services.description: Logos, brand identity, social media posts, UI/UX designs, and marketing graphics.

services.name: AI Video Editing
services.description: Next-gen AI powered video editing, generative video, captions, and AI avatars.

services.name: AI Photoshoots
services.description: Hyper-realistic AI model photoshoots, product staging, and creative portraits without physical cameras.

services.name: Other Services
services.description: Custom tech and creative requests based on client requirements.
